ruleContent.content:
<js>
var jsonStr = java.hexDecodeToString(result);
var params = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
var chapterId = params.item_id;
var source = String(java.get('source') || '').trim();

if (!chapterId) result = '';

else if (source.includes('shuyinfm')) {
    var shuyinId = java.get('shuyinid') || java.get('book_id') || '';
    var timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    var raw = "act=series&id=" + shuyinId + "&mod=movie&movieId=" + chapterId + "&t=" + timestamp + "&token=ecmsapitoken";
    var token = java.md5Encode(raw);
    var apiUrl = "https://weixin.aikeu.com/ecmsapi/index.php?mod=movie&act=series&movieId=" + chapterId + "&id=" + shuyinId + "&t=" + timestamp + "&token=" + token;
    try {
        var resp = java.ajax(apiUrl);
        var data = JSON.parse(resp);
        if (data.code === 1 && data.data && data.data.SeriesUrl) {
            result = data.data.SeriesUrl;
        } else {
            result = '';
        }
    } catch(e) {
        result = '';
    }
}

else if (source.includes('kuwo')) {
    function djb2(str) {
        var h = 5381;
        for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
            h = ((h << 5) + h + str.charCodeAt(i)) & 0xffffffff;
        }
        return h;
    }
    var ts = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    var secret = "your-secret-key-change-in-production";
    var raw = chapterId + "_" + ts + "_" + secret;
    var hash = djb2(raw);
    var hex = (Math.abs(hash) >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    var token = ts + "_" + hex;
    var apiUrl = "https://m.shuyinfm.com/api/kuwo/audio?rid=" + chapterId + "&level=exhigh&token=" + token;
    try {
        var resp = java.ajax(apiUrl);
        var data = JSON.parse(resp);
        result = data.url || data.data && data.data.url || '';
    } catch(e) {
        result = '';
    }
}

else if (source.includes('bilibili')) {
    var bvid = java.get('biliid') || java.get('book_id') || '';
    var apiUrl = "https://m.shuyinfm.com/api/bilibili/audio?bvid=" + bvid + "&cid=" + chapterId;
    try {
        var resp = java.ajax(apiUrl);
        var data = JSON.parse(resp);
        result = data.url || data.data && data.data.url || '';
    } catch(e) {
        result = '';
    }
}

else if (source.includes('yuetingba')) {
    var apiUrl = "http://yuetingba.cn/api/app/docs-listen/" + chapterId + "/ting-with-efi";
    try {
        var resp = java.ajax(apiUrl);
        var data = JSON.parse(resp);
        var efi = data.efi;
        var creationTime = data.creationTime;
        var tingId = data.id;

        function decryptEfi(efi, tingId, creationTime) {
            var tingClean = tingId.replace(/-/g, '');
            var timeStr = creationTime.replace(/-/g, '').replace(/:/g, '').replace(/T/g, '').replace(/\./g, '').replace(/ /g, '');
            var timePadded = timeStr.padEnd(20, '0');

            function gk(t, tm) {
                var r = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i]));
                }
                for (var i = 20; i < t.length; i++) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i - 20]));
                }
                return r;
            }
            function gi(t, tm) {
                var r = '';
                for (var i = 20; i > 4; i--) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i - 1]));
                }
                return r;
            }

            var keyStr = gk(tingClean, timePadded);
            var ivStr = gi(tingClean, timePadded);
            var keyB64 = java.base64Encode(keyStr);
            var ivB64 = java.base64Encode(ivStr);

            var keyBytes = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(keyB64);
            var ivBytes = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(ivB64);
            var ciphertext = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(efi);
            var secretKey = javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, "AES");
            var ivSpec = javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(ivBytes);
            var cipher = javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
            cipher.init(javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, ivSpec);
            var plainBytes = cipher.doFinal(ciphertext);
            var plainText = new Packages.java.lang.String(plainBytes, "UTF-8");
            return plainText;
        }

        var decrypted = decryptEfi(efi, tingId, creationTime);
        var audioPath = '';
        try {
            var resultObj = JSON.parse(decrypted);
            audioPath = resultObj.url || resultObj.audioUrl || resultObj.playUrl || '';
        } catch(e) {
            audioPath = decrypted;
        }
        if (audioPath) {
            var base = "http://36.5.86.125:50011";
            if (audioPath.startsWith('http')) {
                result = audioPath;
            } else {
                result = base + (audioPath.startsWith('/') ? '' : '/') + audioPath;
            }
        } else {
            result = '';
        }
    } catch(e) {
        result = '';
    }
}

else {
    result = '';
}
</js>

<js>
var key = java.get("key") || "";
var page = parseInt(java.get("page") || "");
var base = "https://m.shuyinfm.com/api/search/";
var urls = [
    base + "kuwo?keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) + "&page=" + page + "&pageSize=10",
    base + "yuetingba?keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) + "&page=" + page + "&pageSize=10",
    base + "bilibili?keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) + "&page=" + page + "&pageSize=10&type=video"
];
var books = [];
var seen = {};

function addBook(item) {
    if (item.source === 'bilibili' && !item.bvid) return;
    var mark = String(item.title || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").toLowerCase() + "|" + String(item.author || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").toLowerCase();
    if (!item.title || seen[mark]) return;
    seen[mark] = true;
    books.push(item);
}

try {
    var ecmsData = typeof result === 'string' ? JSON.parse(result) : result;
    if (ecmsData.data && Array.isArray(ecmsData.data.list)) {
        ecmsData.data.list.forEach(function(item) {
            addBook({
                title: item.title,
                author: item.username || item.player || '',
                cover: item.titlepic || '',
                intro: item.moviesay || '',
                id: item.id,
                source: 'shuyinfm'
            });
        });
    }
} catch(e) {}

for (var i = 0; i < urls.length; i++) {
    try {
        var resp = java.ajax(urls[i]);
        var data = JSON.parse(resp);
        if (data.albumlist && Array.isArray(data.albumlist)) {
            data.albumlist.forEach(function(item) {
                addBook({
                    title: item.name,
                    author: item.artist || '',
                    cover: item.img || '',
                    intro: item.info || '',
                    id: item.albumid,
                    source: 'kuwo'
                });
            });
        }
        if (data.results && Array.isArray(data.results)) {
            data.results.forEach(function(item) {
                addBook({
                    title: item.title,
                    author: item.author || '',
                    cover: item.titlepic || '',
                    intro: item.moviesay || '',
                    id: item.idPart || item.id,
                    source: 'yuetingba'
                });
            });
        }
        if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data.list)) {
            data.data.list.forEach(function(item) {
                addBook({
                    title: item.title,
                    author: item.player || '',
                    cover: item.titlepic || '',
                    intro: item.moviesay || '',
                    id: item.bvid || item.aid,
                    bvid: item.bvid,
                    source: 'bilibili'
                });
            });
        }
    } catch(e) {}
}

JSON.stringify({books: books})
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var source = String(java.get('source') || '').trim();
var id = String(java.get('id') || '').trim();
var chapters = [];
var pageSize = 200;

if (source.includes('shuyinfm')) {
    var data = typeof result === 'string' ? JSON.parse(result) : result;
    if (data.data && data.data.moielist) {
        chapters = data.data.moielist.map(function(item) {
            return { name: item.title, id: item.id };
        });
        if (data.data.movid) java.put('shuyinid', data.data.movid);
    }
} else if (source.includes('kuwo')) {
    var firstResp = java.ajax('https://search.kuwo.cn/r.s?stype=albuminfo&albumid=' + id + '&mobi=1&vipver=kwbook_ip_9.2.5.0&pn=0&iskwbook=1&rn=1');
    var firstData = eval('(' + firstResp + ')');
    var total = parseInt(firstData.songnum) || 0;
    if (total > 0) {
        var pages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);
        for (var p = 0; p < pages; p++) {
            var url = 'https://search.kuwo.cn/r.s?stype=albuminfo&albumid=' + id + '&mobi=1&vipver=kwbook_ip_9.2.5.0&pn=' + p + '&iskwbook=1&rn=' + pageSize;
            var resp = java.ajax(url);
            var data = eval('(' + resp + ')');
            if (data.musiclist && Array.isArray(data.musiclist)) {
                data.musiclist.forEach(function(item) {
                    chapters.push({ name: item.name || item.songname || '', id: item.musicrid || item.id || '' });
                });
            }
        }
    }
} else if (source.includes('yuetingba')) {
    java.put('yuetingid', id);
    var page = 1;
    var hasMore = true;
    while (hasMore) {
        var url = 'https://m.shuyinfm.com/api/yuetingba/movielist?workId=' + id + '&page=' + page;
        var resp = java.ajax(url);
        var data = JSON.parse(resp);
        if (data.chapters && Array.isArray(data.chapters)) {
            data.chapters.forEach(function(item) {
                chapters.push({ name: item.title, id: item.id });
            });
            if (data.chapters.length < pageSize) hasMore = false;
            else page++;
        } else {
            hasMore = false;
        }
    }
} else if (source.includes('bilibili')) {
    java.put('biliid', id);
    var resp = java.ajax('https://api.bilibili.com/x/player/pagelist?bvid=' + id);
    var data = JSON.parse(resp);
    if (data.code === 0 && Array.isArray(data.data)) {
        chapters = data.data.map(function(item) {
            return { name: item.part || '', id: item.cid };
        });
    }
}
JSON.stringify({chapterlist: chapters});
</js>

function getMainUrl(jsonStr) {
  try {
    var data = typeof jsonStr === 'string' ? JSON.parse(jsonStr) : jsonStr;
    var infos = data.data.video_model_infos || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < infos.length; i++) {
      var info = infos[i];
      if (!info.video_model || info.video_model === "") {
        continue;
      }
      var model = JSON.parse(info.video_model);
      var videoList = model.video_list || [];
      for (var j = 0; j < videoList.length; j++) {
        var video = videoList[j];
        if (video.main_url) {
          return video.main_url;
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

var mainUrl = getMainUrl(result);
result = mainUrl || "未找到视频链接";
</js>
